Transaction.title: Transaction
Transaction.description: A personal income or expense record belonging to a user for a specific month and day.

title.description: Short description of where money went or came from (1-100 chars).

amount.description: Transaction amount in Rupiah (positive integer up to 1,000,000,000,000).

type.description: Whether this transaction is an expense or income.

categoryName.description: Denormalized display name of the category.

paymentMethod.description: Payment method used for the transaction.

dateMillis.description: Transaction date as Unix epoch milliseconds.

dayOfMonth.description: Day of the month (1-31) for daily balance charts.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp set via FieldValue.serverTimestamp() on creation.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp set via FieldValue.serverTimestamp() on creation and update.

Category.title: Category
Category.description: An expense or income category customized or used by the user.

budgetLimit.description: Optional monthly budget cap in Rupiah (0 means no cap).

createdAt.description: Server timestamp set via FieldValue.serverTimestamp() on creation.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp set via FieldValue.serverTimestamp() on creation and update.

MonthConfig.title: MonthConfig
MonthConfig.description: Monthly opening balance and budget configuration for a given YYYY-MM period.

openingBalance.description: Starting balance at the beginning of the month in Rupiah.

monthlyBudget.description: Target monthly spending budget in Rupiah (0 means unset).

createdAt.description: Server timestamp set via FieldValue.serverTimestamp() on creation.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp set via FieldValue.serverTimestamp() on creation and update.

/users/{userId}/transactions/{transactio.description: User-scoped personal finance transactions (expenses and incomes).

/users/{userId}/monthConfigs/{monthId}.description: User-scoped monthly opening balance and budget targets keyed by YYYY-MM.
